tax_incentive_assumptions.ira_section_45w: Hypothetical 40,000 USD capex offset throughout the benchmark, not current-law entitlement. IRS guidance excludes vehicles acquired after September 30, 2025; eligibility before termination still requires verification. No-offset sensitivity is reported.
tax_incentive_assumptions.section_30c: Hypothetical 7,500 USD charger capex offset. IRS guidance excludes property placed in service after June 30, 2026; earlier eligibility and percentages are not established for this illustrative case.
